tools.name: list_websites
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which websites their Supovia support chat runs on, or a website's id is needed. Returns each website's id, name, domain and whether its AI customer agent is on, most recently edited first, 20 per page by default. Not for customer conversations.

tools.name: get_website
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one of their Supovia websites by name or id, such as whether its AI customer agent is on. Returns the website's id, name, domain, AI-agent status and created and edited times, or not-found. Not for the help articles published on it.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which customer conversations are open, unread or recently active, optionally for one website. Returns conversation ids with website, channel, resolved flag, unread count and times, most recent activity first, 20 per page by default (no message text or customer details). No

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one customer conversation's status, such as whether it is resolved or unread and how many messages the customer, staff and AI agent sent. Returns its channel, status, unread count, times and sender counts from the latest 50 public messages (no message text or interna

tools.name: get_unresolved_conversation_counts
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how many customer conversations are still open or unresolved, in total or per website. Returns the total plus a per-website count, largest first, listing up to 100 websites (no customer or message data). Not for finding which conversations are open.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which help articles or support docs exist, optionally for one website, language or article. Returns each article's id, title, slug, language, website and published flag, most recently edited first, 20 per page by default, without the article text. Not for finding articles

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Use this when someone needs the text of one help-center article, to quote it or answer a customer from it. Returns the article's title, slug, language, published flag and text up to 20000 characters, with the text's format (html, markdown, plain-text). Not for finding articles on a topic.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which help article covers a topic or question on one of their websites. Returns up to 5 matching published articles with id, title, slug and language, matched by meaning in one language (English by default). Not for reading an article's text.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which email campaigns one of their websites has. Returns each campaign's id, name and created and edited times, 20 per page by default (no recipients, subject or content). Not for sending a campaign.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Use this when the user approves an exact reply to send to a customer in one Supovia conversation. Returns the conversation id and send time. The reply reaches the customer on the conversation's own channels (chat, email, WhatsApp or Messenger); replies to app-store reviews are public. Not for intern

tools.name: resolve_conversation
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to mark a customer conversation resolved or done, or reopen it. Returns the conversation id, resolved state and last edit time, and the operator dashboard updates live. Repeating the same state has no further effect. Not for replying to the customer.

tools.name: open_supovia
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to open Supovia and browse their workspace interactively. Support websites, conversation activity and help articles. Starts with up to 100 items. Not for changing data.

tools.name: show_support_overview
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a quick visual summary of their customer support. Returns a card with up to 20 websites (name, domain, AI agent on or off) and the 20 most recently active conversations (channel, open or resolved, times), optionally for one website. Not for complete open-conversation tota

tools.name: show_customer_inbox
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to see their unread customer conversations in an inbox view. Returns how many of the 50 most recently active conversations have unread messages; the view lists up to 20 with channel, status, unread count and times (no message text or customer details). Not for complete op

tools.name: open_customer_inbox_conversation
tools.description: Use this when the embedded Supovia inbox opens a conversation the user selected. Returns whether it was found and gives the view its channel, status, unread count and times (no message text or customer details). Not for questions asked in chat.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_websites, list_conversations, get_conversation, get_unresolved_conversation_counts, get_document, list_campaigns, show_customer_inbox, open_customer_inbox_conversation · Private data: list_documents, get_document, search_documents · Public sink: list_campaigns, send_message · Destructive: get_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_websites, list_conversations, get_conversation, get_unresolved_conversation_counts, get_document, list_campaigns, show_customer_inbox, open_customer_inbox_conversation · Private data: list_documents, get_document, search_documents · Public sink: list_campaigns, send_message · Destructive: get_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
